title: betula davurica f. tiliifolia
intro: Betula davurica f. tiliifolia, commonly known as Korean Birch, is a plant species in the family Betulaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Betula davurica f. tiliifolia include soothing and calming effects on the skin, as well as reducing fever and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
